market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely range-bound with elevated volatility. RBA rate decision and US-Iran escalation are dominant catalysts. Financials under pressure from credit stress; materials and energy provide relative strength. CTX.AX and QAN.AX are near-term laggards.
market_outlook.long_term: Productivity deterioration and fiscal debt trajectory cap upside. Energy transition cost overruns and housing correction risk create headwinds. Gold, gas, and rare earths offer structural outperformance. ASX 200 likely to underperform global indices unless RBA pivots dovish.
